thread:
Riya (PM): Quick sync — proposing a small feature set for Dedicated to reduce autoscale jitter and give customers transparent burst accounting.
Riya (PM): Problem: customers hit transient spikes, autoscaler flaps, and then get surprised by hidden burst usage. Proposal = (1) autoscale hysteresis windows per pool, (2) tenant-visible burst ledger in Console with per-window carryover, (3) soft/hard burst caps with graceful fallback routes.
Diego (SRE): +1 on hysteresis. Need to quantify safe windows. What's the default? 30s? 2min?
Chen (Eng): Implementation notes: hysteresis is cheap — keep a moving median of request rate per pool and require sustained delta before scale decision. Burst ledger needs periodic aggregation (per-tenant token counts) — can reuse billing pipeline.
Amanda (Sales): Customers asking for visibility — if we show burst usage they may shift to Dedicated. We need clear billing language for carryover.
Riya (PM): MVP launch criteria: 1) autopilot avoids >2x scale flaps in 5min for synthetic spike tests, 2) Console shows per-tenant burst usage with 1m resolution, 3) fallback route enforces soft cap and returns structured 429+payload explaining fallback.
Diego (SRE): Metrics to track: scale decisions/sec, flaps per pool, 95th token latency, fallback rate. Also oncall playbook for incorrect cap enforcement.
Chen (Eng): Rough effort: hysteresis + tests 1.5 sprint, ledger UI + backend 2 sprints, fallback routing 1 sprint. Need infra for per-tenant windows and reconciliation job.
Riya (PM): I'll add to roadmap backlog. Can @Chen pick engineering owner and @Diego own rollout playbook? :thumbsup:
Chen (Eng): I can own eng work. Will post a short RFC with design diagrams and perf numbers.
Diego (SRE): I'll draft a runbook and monitoring dashboards.
AutoDeployBot: Deployment scheduled: feature-flag gate will be created (ff/dedicated-burst-ledger).
Amanda (Sales): I'll prepare customer comms and updated contract language for carryover.
Riya (PM): Thanks all — aim to target pilot for 1 key customer next quarter. Follow-ups: Chen to RFC by EOW, Diego runbook draft by Tue.
